Mystery “black triangles” are haunting our skies with nearly 2,000 sightings logged in the past five years by UFO Identified researchers.

Nadeem Badshah and Richard Ault

19:26, 01 Nov 2026Updated 19:26, 01 Nov 2026

Manchester is the latest city to be hit by a UFO epidemic that’s gripping the UK, experts have said. Mystery “black triangles” are haunting our skies with nearly 2,000 sightings logged in the past five years by UFO Identified researchers.

‌

‌

They include 164 reports of the strange wedge-shaped objects, silently gliding over housing estates and farmland before zooming off at incredible speeds.

‌

In the most recent report on July 22, witnesses spotted a “large black triangle” boasting a red light hovering over Stretford in Greater Manchester for more than 30 minutes.

‌

Ash Ellis, founder of UFO Identified, said: “There are thousands of people across the UK who have seen something they could not readily explain, but the reports are often difficult to find once initial interest has passed.”

Earlier this year, a “perfect triangle” was seen speeding across the sky above Chesterfield, Derbyshire.

Other spooky incidents include a “black V-shaped boomerang” spotted over the Fylde coast in Lancashire and a soundless black wedge above Exmouth, Devon.

Orbs, spheres and “star-like” sightings make up the bulk of British sightings, researchers said.

‌

It comes after Pentagon chiefs in the US recently unveiled their latest release of declassified UFO files.

According to the report, a black triangular object hovered silently 300 feet in the air before whisking away into a canyon at high speed without leaving a trail.

‌

Elsewhere, ex-US president Barack Obama has said the chances Earth has been visited by aliens is "low".

He said: "They're real but I haven't seen them.
